## 1. Executive Summary

Jordan Masopust is the Founder of Snowfield LLC and an AI implementation, workflow architecture, solutions engineering, and revenue operations specialist based in Indianapolis, Indiana (working remote, nationwide). Across enterprise restaurant technology support, high-volume B2B inside sales, regulated mortgage lending, multi-unit P&L operations, and independent B2B consulting, his work focuses on identifying operational bottlenecks on high-volume floors and shipping practical AI and workflow systems that non-technical teams actually adopt.

Jordan holds a Bachelor of Science in Psychology (Minor in Biology) from Purdue University through Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis (2020) and has publicly built and tested language-model workflows since the GPT-3 era in 2020.

## 2. Core Competencies & Target Role Alignment

- **AI Implementation & Enablement:** End-to-end design, prompt architecture, non-hallucination data guardrails, user documentation, executive rollout proposals, and team onboarding across Claude (Anthropic), Google Gemini, and OpenAI.
- **Forward Deployed Engineering:** Embedded discovery on live operational floors, rapid prototyping in Python, JavaScript, React, SQL, and HTML/CSS, and translating compliance or domain constraints into production daily workflows.
- **Solutions Engineering & Pre-Sales:** Technical discovery, live product demonstrations (including corporate franchisee POS demos), unit-economics ROI modeling, price-objection frameworks, and prospect-branded workflow previews.
- **Revenue Operations (RevOps):** Speed-to-lead automation, missed-call and web-inquiry quote routing, CRM/dialer cadences across 750+ accounts, live-transfer closing workflows, and case-dispatch optimization.
- **Knowledge Operations:** Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) publishing, large-scale knowledge-base auditing, source-cited retrieval architectures, and cross-model QA verification pipelines.

## 3. Snowfield LLC — Studio Overview & Commercial Offer

- **Entity:** Snowfield LLC (Founded 2026; Remote, nationwide)
- **Founder:** Jordan Masopust
- **Website:** https://snowfieldhq.github.io/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/snowfieldhq
- **Contact:** jordan.masopust@gmail.com

### Commercial Service: Missed-Call Text-Back & Quote-Booking Systems
Snowfield LLC builds missed-call and web-inquiry response workflows for owner-operated high-ticket trades (primary focus: residential roofing and heating-and-cooling contractors) and external small businesses.
- **Architecture:** Connects one agreed phone route and one existing web inquiry source to structured intake questions, an immediate owner alert, and a booking link or quote-request handoff inside accounts the client owns outright (revocable studio access). Eligible follow-up stops automatically on reply, booking, or STOP opt-out.
- **Pricing & Terms:** Standard setup is $1,150; ongoing email-only support (powered by Snowfield's AI assistants using a fixed monthly routing/opt-out/handoff checklist) is $297/month starting only after written go-live acceptance. Customer software, usage, and carrier registration are billed directly to the client and estimated before payment. Full terms: https://snowfieldhq.github.io/scope.html.
- **Unit-Economics Transparency:** Hypothetical roofing example ($14,500 ticket x 32% contribution = $4,640 per job; illustrative first-year total ~$6,198.42 / $4,640 = 1.34 jobs). Hypothetical HVAC example ($9,200 ticket x 38% contribution = $3,496 per job; ~$6,198.42 / $3,496 = 1.77 jobs). Examples are illustrative and not promised results.

### Internal & Client Systems Builds under Snowfield LLC (2026–Present)
1. **Multi-Model Memory & Blind Verification Pipeline:** Engineered Snowfield's local memory and cross-model verification system spanning Claude, Google Gemini, and OpenAI, requiring every technical specification and client deliverable to be independently verified by a second model against primary source records before release.
2. **Offline-Capable Live-Call Sales Closing Console:** Engineered an offline-capable closing console in JavaScript and Python for contractor discovery calls, combining trade-specific discovery questions, a six-step price-objection waterfall, live unit-economics calculators, and prospect-branded quote-flow previews published directly from the local workspace.
3. **Interactive Multi-Role Restaurant Training Web Prototype:** Built an eight-iteration interactive training web application derived from restaurant operating manuals, with tailored role views for floor, kitchen, and management staff.
4. **Artis Designs (Completed B2B Client Engagement):** Conducted marketplace demand research and executed a comprehensive audit of 550+ legacy design and template files across the client's VCarve Pro library for a custom wood-sign manufacturer.
